verdict: Paid Instagram is profitable this period, but purchase volume is thin and lead cost is climbing.
diagnosis: Instagram ads returned $11,972 on $2,167 spend this period — a 5.5x return, but only 63 pixel-tracked purchases.

signals.headline: Ads returned $5.52 per $1 spent
signals.detail: $2,167 spend produced $11,972 in tracked purchase value this period. Healthy return, but sample size is small.

signals.headline: Only 63 pixel purchases in 28 days
signals.detail: Purchase volume is low despite 8.9M impressions. Suggests narrow buyer pool or leaky checkout funnel.

signals.headline: 237 add-to-carts, 94 checkouts started
signals.detail: Roughly 40% of carts reached checkout. Drop-off between cart and purchase is where money is leaking.

signals.headline: Cost per lead sits at $4.94
signals.detail: 438 pixel leads on $2,167 spend. Reasonable for food and beverage, but leads aren't converting to buyers fast enough.

signals.headline: 952 new followers, 357 profile visits
signals.detail: Organic Instagram is building an audience. Engagement is real but not yet translating into subscription signups.

benchmark.label: BENCHMARK
benchmark.body: Food and beverage brands average <cite index="3-4">4.5%–6.0%</cite> conversion. Paid social usually converts <cite index="3-7">under 1%</cite>. Healthy return on ad spend sits in the <cite index="5-6">3:1 to 5:1</cite> band.

seasonal.label: SEASONAL
seasonal.body: July and August are peak grilling months for DTC meat. Demand is elevated but ad auctions are crowded. <cite index="6-1">88% of subscription brands report higher acquisition costs</cite> in 2025.

competitor.label: COMPETITOR
competitor.body: Meat subscription market projected to grow from <cite index="8-5">$1.7 billion in 2024 to $7.1 billion by 2034</cite>. Good Ranchers now pushes <cite index="13-7">tariff-proof locked pricing</cite> as a wedge.

recommendations.title: Fix the cart-to-checkout drop before adding spend
recommendations.detail: 237 carts became 94 checkouts and 63 purchases. Consider testing shipping cost transparency, guest checkout, and payment options before scaling budget.

recommendations.title: Test an annual subscription option to cut churn
recommendations.detail: Annual billing can reduce monthly-equivalent churn by <cite index="1-8">60-80%</cite>. Worth exploring for the Muslim Subscription Box to lock in lifetime value.

recommendations.title: Convert 6,654 Instagram followers into buyers
recommendations.detail: Organic reach is building but only 63 tracked purchases landed. Test a followers-only offer or email capture flow to activate the warm audience.
